title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 16.1 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 16.1 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browsers of users viewing Error Tracking pages. This occurs due to improper sanitization of user input, leading to a cross-site scripting (XSS) issue. The vulnerability has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
